references.context: Category theory: overcategory or slice category whose objects are arrows into X

references.phrase: there exists an object X of C
references.disposition: Existence of a representing object, not an assertion that the fibred category is representable by a scheme.

review_rationale: Reviewed the entire fibred-groupoid representability criterion, distinguished equivalence in the 2-category of categories over C from an ordinary set-valued representable functor, and preserved the overcategory C/X as an unassigned construction.
